basis: Static reading of electron-chrome-extensions 4.9.0, Acira desktop/browser-services, Electron 44.9.3 docs/binary strings, Chromium 152 schemas; no app was launched.

sources.node_modules/electron-chrome-extensions/: ECE 4.9.0 renderer preload: builds the chrome.* surface (apiDefinitions), ExtensionEvent, ChromeSetting stubs, noop stubs.
ECE 4.9.0 main process: router + handlers for browserAction, windows, tabs, webNavigation, contextMenus, runtime (native msg), cookies, notifications, commands, permissions.
ECE support matrix (which members are implemented, unchecked = missing) and the Electron webRequest limitation.
sources.node_modules/electron/dist/electron.exe: Strings scanned for registered extension function/feature names (C:\ae\r9\shim-tools\scan-electron.cjs); evidence of native names only.
sources.electron docs api/extensions.md: Electron docs "Supported Extensions APIs" (fetched from github main): native runtime, tabs, storage, scripting, webRequest, management, extension, devtools.
Acira main-process side of offscreen, identity, sidePanel, userScripts, idle, bookmarks/history/sessions/search, runtime.getContexts, tabs.captureVisibleTab, permissions.contains and windows fixes.
sources.desktop/browser-services/extension-apis-: Acira renderer side (written into the ECE preload): namespace definitions, DNR wrappers, constants, browser mirror, runtime additions.
sources.desktop/browser-services/extension-shims: storage.sync -> storage.local shim added to store-package content scripts.
sources.desktop/browser-services/extension-runti: Patches the ECE preload text: lastError for native messaging, drops Object.freeze, hasListener/hasListeners, injects Acira definitions.
sources.desktop/browser-services/extension-store: Read-only bookmarks/history/sessions API answers from Acira stores.
sources.desktop/browser-services/extension-side-: Native views that dock the chrome.sidePanel page beside the page area.
sources.desktop/browser-services/extension-tab-c: Replaces ECE tabs.getCurrent so it returns the caller's tab.
sources.desktop/browser-services/extension-new-t: chrome_url_overrides.newtab shown as an explicit per-extension choice (manifest feature, no chrome.* API).
sources.desktop/browser-services/extension-toolb: Attaches the ECE runtime and <browser-action-list> to Acira's UI (+ extension-toolbar-preload.cjs, extension-action-sizing.cjs popup sizing).
sources.desktop/browser-services/extension-manag: Creates the ECE runtime per profile session, wires native messaging, Acira APIs, patched preload, requestPermissions dialog, install/load/remove.
sources.desktop/browser-services/dnr-host.cjs: DNR host: loads rulesets, handles getMatchedRules/setExtensionActionOptions/aciraSync, badge counts, request-pipeline participants.
sources.desktop/browser-services/dnr-engine.cjs: DNR matcher (block, redirect, allow, upgradeScheme, modifyHeaders, allowAllRequests).
sources.desktop/browser-services/user-scripts.cj: chrome.userScripts registry, validation and match patterns.
sources.desktop/main.cjs: extensionBrowser(profile) (lines 139-169): the ECE impl callbacks createTab/createWindow/removeWindow/selectTab/removeTab/assignTabDetails/stores/sidePanel; extensionCreateTab (756).
sources.desktop/request-pipeline.cjs: Registers Electron session.webRequest listeners (onBeforeRequest/onHeadersReceived/onBeforeSendHeaders/onCompleted/onErrorOccurred) which shadow chrome.webRequest.
sources.desktop/content-blocking.cjs: Calls the DNR host from the request pipeline (lines 81-98).
sources.docs/launch/EXTENSION_COMPATIBILITY.md: Acira's measured compatibility notes and API fixture results.
sources.C:\\ae\\r4\\ext\\evidence: Real-app probes: Object.keys(chrome) per extension, API fixture result (used to confirm which namespaces exist natively).
sources.C:\\ae\\r9\\chromium-api: Chromium 152.0.7977.167 extension API schemas used to list the members each namespace should have (chrome-members.cjs).

windows.get.notes: Chromium 152's windows_util / WindowsGetFunction: the caller's window for WINDOW_ID_CURRENT, populate, windowTypes, 'No window with id: N.'. Web pop-ups opened by pages (window.open) are not listed.

windows.getCurrent.notes: The caller's own window (the tab's window, or the window an engine popup belongs to); a service worker gets the focused window, else the one created last.

windows.getLastFocused.notes: Most recently active window of the asked types (activation order); populate and windowTypes honoured.

windows.getAll.notes: Every window of the profile an extension may see (ordinary windows and extension popup windows; never private, Tor, web-app or other-profile windows), populate and windowTypes honoured.

windows.create.notes: left/top/width/height (checked against the displays, size-only fitted onto a display), focused, state, type normal | popup | panel, url(s) with Chromium's errors; popup = a chromeless window in the profile's session. tabId opens the tab's address in the new window and closes the old tab (Acira's own Move to new window: the page loads again, the tab id changes). Deferred: setSelfAsOpener, focused:false for ordinary windows (Acira shows them itself), an extension page in type normal opens as a popup-style window, only the first url of a popup; incognito refused ('Incognito mode is disabled.').

windows.update.notes: state (normal, minimized, maximized, fullscreen; locked-fullscreen as fullscreen), left/top/width/height, focused, drawAttention, with Chromium's validation errors; answers the window as it became.

windows.remove.notes: Closes the window (Acira's own close prompts apply); 'No window with id: N.' for anything the extension may not see.

windows.onCreated.notes: Sent when the engine is handed a new window (its first page), once; windowTypes filter; no tabs in the event.

windows.onRemoved.notes: Sent when the window closes (by the extension or the person), windowTypes filter by the type this context learnt.

crossCutting: ECE invokeExtension swallows handler errors: the promise resolves undefined and the error goes to console.error; chrome.runtime.lastError is never set for ECE-backed calls (preload:58-64). Acira's own APIs use call() which rejects / sets lastError.
The ECE preload logs every API call, result and event to the extension console ("if (true) console.log", preload:24, 47, 65): noisy and includes arguments.
Event objects ignore Chrome's filter arguments (UrlFilter, UpdateFilter, extraInfoSpec): addListener(callback) only; hasListener/hasListeners fixed by Acira (extension-runtime-patch.cjs:27).

ECE injects tabs, windows, cookies, notifications, webNavigation, contextMenus, commands, permissions, downloads, topSites, privacy regardless of manifest permissions, and its handlers do not check permissions.

Only tabs whose page exists are tracked (attachTab); sleeping or not-yet-loaded tabs are invisible to tabs.query. Acira never emits "tab-updated", so pin, group and sleep changes do not reach tabs.onUpdated.
Extensions are disabled in private windows and Tor windows; one ECE runtime exists per ordinary profile session.

Library "if (shouldInject)" definitions are overwritten with spread(...base) first, so native members stay unless the library lists the same name (e.g. extension.getViews, webRequest.onHeadersReceived, topSites).
